context: A barista and a customer chat about post-work plans
purpose: Teach: 怪我/平日/うどん/パーセント/引く/映画館/食堂/出勤

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いらっしゃいませ。お仕事帰りですか？平日のこの時間は珍しいですね。
lines.en: Welcome. Just off work? It's unusual to see you on a weekday at this hour.
lines.style: Warm professional greeting with friendly curiosity, soft welcoming tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうなんです。今日は早めに出勤したので、もう上がれちゃって。
lines.en: That's right. I went in early today, so I could already clock out.
lines.style: Cheerful and a little proud, light airy delivery with a smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 羨ましいです。このあと、どこかへ寄られるんですか？
lines.en: I'm jealous. Are you stopping by somewhere after this?
lines.style: Casual conversational lean-in, gentle curiosity with a small laugh.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 近くの映画館に観たい作品があって、今日は五十パーセント引きの日なんです。
lines.en: There's a film I want to see at the nearby cinema, and today's the fifty-percent-off day.
lines.style: Bright and excited, slightly faster pace when sharing the plan.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わあ、お得ですね。実は私、先週そこに行ったとき足をひねって、ちょっと怪我しちゃったんですよ。
lines.en: Wow, what a deal. Actually, when I went there last week I twisted my ankle and got a little hurt.
lines.style: Light laugh at her own clumsiness, sharing a small relatable mishap warmly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ええ、大丈夫ですか？無理しないでくださいね。じゃあ私も気をつけて歩きます。
lines.en: Oh no, are you okay? Please don't push yourself. I'll watch my step too then.
lines.style: Genuine concern with soft worried tone, sincere check-in before reassurance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もうすっかり平気ですよ。映画のあとは何か食べて帰られますか？
lines.en: I'm completely fine now. Are you grabbing something to eat after the movie?
lines.style: Reassuring smile, then naturally pivoting with curious friendly tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうですね、下の食堂でうどんでも食べて帰ろうかなって思ってます。
lines.en: Yeah, I'm thinking of having some udon at the canteen downstairs before heading home.
lines.style: Dreamy and content, soft tone imagining the warm meal ahead.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あそこの天ぷらうどん、体が温まりますよ。じゃあラテ、ご用意しますね。
lines.en: The tempura udon there really warms you up. I'll get your latte ready then.
lines.style: Soft recommendation with gentle nostalgia, then smooth professional closing.
